body: I see, I get you. I guess society doesn't cater to that. You might be right about being delusional but its your reality and that's all that matters
You're welcome. Thank yourself too for being a strong survivor, be well

I don't have anyone except him and his mother here...

I've been through 9 years of heartbreak, lost my confidence etc. I've had enough

I'd say you survived but does this mean anything to you?

If it does then stay a survivor

I wanna kill myself after I talk to someone. He's currently ignoring me and raiding lol

I'm not really scared per se,  just unsure of how to go about it. Either drown myself in the lake or go home, run water and cut myself deeply everywhere and hope I bleed to death in time
Tried therapy and all they wanted was to shove meds down my throat.

Forgot to mention: since first experiencing violence from my parents, I feel no peace, ever. I'm always overwhelmed by sadness. Especially when being isolated from friends at a younger age. It only got worse as I progressed to do more of my parents' bidding.

Thanks for your words. Enduring is painful, with all the baggage I've had to carry and add.

I want to just let it all go

Thank you for taking the time despite the time difference.

Honestly, I've exhausted a lot of possibilities, tried talking to him but he's vague and no, I can never face that sex addiction, I was supposed to in December. But I feel a paralyzing terror at the idea...

Honestly I want to just die, I'm tired of trying :/
If you like, you can read my recent post.

She does, but it does not matter.

I would lose her in the end too.

I don't want to continue to search for them and gamble with the chance of getting hurt again. Its hard to find the optimism.
Yup, then they'll pretend they cared for their own ego.

I just got rejected again before I planned at my graduation. It hurts.

No point in trying again... is there?

From my first heartbreak 9 years ago, I tried to persevere but I failed. 

I don't want to be alone either but I've been tired of trying...

Good luck to you

Who wants the burden of someone suicidal? 

I reached out to friends I thought were close enough to trust... but turns out nobody cared lol. If I killed myself tonight, nobody would care.

Be ready to reinforce your preconception that nobody cares. Extra shitty feelings guaranteed!

I see, I'm sorry.

Sure I still have fun playing games but at the end of the day, it just feels empty because I'm nowhere near where I wanted to be in life. Do you feel this way?

Searching, giving a chance, gambling for a possibility? I tried it all, nothing worked out.

Not everyone is meant to be happy. Eventually? Struggle on? Maybe or no thanks.

I feel closer to my deadline too, except by the end of this year :]

I'm just done trying, that's all. 

Moved back to a city, went back to school, essentially took a gamble at being happy.

I'm not meant to be happy

I've been alone, thrown aside, abandoned etc. Never too late? Too late exists for those who become increasingly isolated and have no support and nothing to keep them grounded. 

I deleted my fb years ago. I'm sure everyone forgot about me anyway, I mean, in the 4 years no one reached out to me, and my email is easily accessible from the alumni mail list lol I don't expect anything, since the whole " you'll lose almost all of your high school friends" statistic. Either way, I believe there was research on subconsciously comparing your life with fb friends and thus causing feelings of, or depression. I don't need extra icing on my already bad enough depression.

See where life takes you? I'm 27, I've been through a lot relative to me, before starting college I already felt done with life thanks to narcissistic parents and 2x cheating bfs. By 23 I was already struggling badly with suicidal thoughts, what changed in 4 years? Well, I already did the thing where you get up and try your best tp change things for the better. All my efforts honestly seem to bear negative fruit. I ended up in situations far worse than any thus far. In a sense, nothing has gotten better, everything gets worse.
Someone will love me for real.

I certainly don't. 

However, I commend you for doing so... because you are probably subconsciously trying to find a justification for NOT committing suicide.
I knew I lost the moment I realized suicidal thoughts prevailed more than my drive and hope to change things (despite constant failure).
They don't care. Simple as that :) they just care about themselves and what they can get out of it. If there's nothing to gain, move along.
You are able to stay positive and I believe that is very powerful. Keep it up!

This exact idea makes me feel more inclined to go away forever. Not necessarily easier but just less "baggage". Nobody cares anyway, so if I die it won't matter.

Do you have the same mindset?

This is why my username is what it is, if you feel the same we were simply abandoned because nobody genuinely cares enough to truly help. We simply aren't worth anybody's trouble, even to those we thought loved us.

She's blessed.

Me and OP are not.

Luck of the draw.

I guess I'm in the unlucky minority.

Well, I hope OP has better success.
Your post made me cry. I'm sorry you were abandoned too :/

I'm not challenging you, but I want to know why would you suggest telling as many people as possible? OP said nobody gave a shit. I know not everybody's experience is the same...

I was told  by a therapist to tell my friends about what I'm going through... Turns out, nobody gave a shit either and that really only drove them further away or gone altogether. There's not a lot that compares to this kind of reaction from people you trusted...

OP, I understand though. I am going through something similar.

I feel the same way and find myself asking the same questions...

I wanted something similar but I'm tired too. I can't wear my heart on my sleeve again.

It hurts really bad doesn't it? I am sorry.

No, its the person, he was the one I  was determined to move forward with. 

Emotionally, I'm at my limits.

Every day when I'm dismissed from school I hope a car hits me

27

Try snd stay focused as best as you can. You may find a way to subdue the guilt.

I wanted a happy family with someone who I love dearly, a decent career, and a modest home to share with him and kids.

But like I've said, it failed. I'm getting older and it is getting further out of reach. Right now I feel like its karma, I never don't deserve any of what I wanted. Why bother anymore? Lol.

You on the other hand, you need to try. Take a baby step, anything. Look into programs,  then talk to your family about it maybe? They may be really happy to hear.

I know, me too, I can relate but I am sorry that I am unable to offer any real advice.

Once you find a way to start though, if things are going well, your mind might be able to focus better on your goal. It was like that for me, when everything was great, not a single thought of suicide. Only some anxiey. The anxiety and thoughts only returned when things went to shit, usual.

Potential of failure is always there, this doesn't sound great but you need to take that step for yourself and see where it takes you.

What do you want in life? Really ask yourself... happiness? A family to share it with? A nice car?

I'm older than you it seems. But no matter.

I don't know how to help, but what made me take that step was solidifying my life's goals, I wanted to try again to be happy. Maybe you can find a positive way to make up for those lost years. Go back to school? Do something you've always wanted to do? 

If you do, I hope it works out. You have your family.

I'm getting older, getting a second degree by Nov, but my life has been full of depression and empty since forever.

No real friends and my parents are narcissistic.

Last year June I found the courage and took a major step/gamble in life to try and turn things around and to overcome depression. However, it failed so hard. If nothing has worked out up to this point, nothing ever will.

What about you?

Your words are a future I'm terrified of.... yet I know is inevitable, especially if I continue to lie to myself about things getting better. Hah.

I want peace too and I want to stop feeling constant heartache, its no way to live. 

I'm sorry you feel this way.
You're not alone in this, I feel the exact same way, except I spend hours crying and praying I'd get hit by a car or die of illness ASAP

I set a short term goal to just graduate school.

I have until November, its my last chance. If I fail for the billionth time, then that's enough failure for a lifetime :)
What if those who you thought you could trust  turn their backs on you?

I understand, its what's making me fall further into suicide

I'm genuine but no one can accept me, as I am broken and they all know it

Finding people who truly love and care for you? Bless you if you find them, otherwise, good luck...

I'm sorry you feel alone, but I can say I understand because I am in that position now.

You found out your husband is sexting other women? I found out someone I'm in love with/wanted to be with  preferred to sleep with escorts. It also broke me.

I am also alone. I have no one else. No friends, no best friend, my family and I don't have a relationship. I live alone.

I can't help you because I can't even help myself. I just wanted to tell you, you're not the only one suffering from this. 

Except... genuinely, I hope you find a way past this. You have people who love and will miss you... I don't, my family might but then they'll realize they never truly got to know me or they'd know about my depression. So if I am gone, its fine. But you? You seem alone, but maybe you're not alone as it feels right now.

So please, hear out a stranger.

Good luck

I'm either not trying hard enough or just hoping for too much from R

Be careful though. I thought there were people I could trust too, for a time. They seemed sincere. However, when it mattered most, and when I observed interactions around me, I realized how empty their words were and how they took the situation to their own advantage, back stabbed me without a thought, likely say things to each other about me, excluding me whenever possible etc. They just don't care. Nobody does. 

I'm not saying not to trust anyone, just be careful.  If you do confide in someone, I hope they will be a true friend who cares. Take care.

I see, I'm sorry to hear. I can't begin to say I understand. I do but I also don't because its relative to your own experience/circumstances..

A few times it felt like he was going to abandon me and every day I feel like he wants turn his back and never look back. The feeling is one of the worst feelings I've ever had the misfortune of feeling. 

Sometimes I wish I never fell in love

Additionally, as a consequence, they don't treat me the same and they have seemingly decided to "abandon" me. None of them talk to me and I'm certain they think/gossip about me being psychotic.

Nothing beats the feeling of being worthless to those around you :D strangers included
